-- Script Scan Dex Explorer-like Structure - Save to Krnl Workspace TXT
local function dumpInstance(instance, indent)
    local indentStr = string.rep("  ", indent)
    local line = indentStr .. instance.Name .. " (" .. instance.ClassName .. ")\n"
    local content = line
    
    -- Sort children untuk urutan rapi
    local children = instance:GetChildren()
    table.sort(children, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
    
    for _, child in ipairs(children) do
        content = content .. dumpInstance(child, indent + 1)
    end
    
    return content
end

-- Timestamp untuk nama file
local timestamp = os.date("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
local filename = "dex_scan_" .. timestamp .. ".txt"

-- Dump hierarchy ke string
local fullContent = "-- Dex Explorer Scan - " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") .. "\n\n"
fullContent = fullContent .. dumpInstance(game, 0)

-- Simpan ke workspace Krnl (writefile)
writefile(filename, fullContent)

print("Scan selesai! File TXT disimpan di folder workspace Krnl: " .. filename)
print("Buka via ZArchiver atau file manager lain untuk liat full hierarchy.")

                    end)
                end)
            end
        end

        -- Ana çapraz platform
        local mainCF = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45))
        remote:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", mainCF, workspace)
        
        for i,v in workspace:GetChildren() do

                remote:InvokeServer("SyncResize", {

                        CFrame = mainCF,
                        Size = Vector3.new(300, 10, 300)

                        Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)

                })
                
                remote:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {[1] = v}, true)
                break
            end
        end
        
        -- Daire şeklinde küçük platformlar
        local radius = 100
        local numPlatforms = 8
        
        for i = 1, numPlatforms do
            local angle = (i / numPlatforms) * math.pi * 2
            local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
            local z = math.sin(angle) * radius
            
            local platformCF = CFrame.new(x, 20, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45))
